rules.skillPhaseDisposition: Retain the current one-cue-per-skill catalogue; shared miss/impact may be reused only at host-confirmed events. New phase-specific cues require a separate sourced proposal; do not fabricate sixty runtime keys.
rules.delivery: 18 draft variants plus provenance, format and measured peak/loudness/duration manifest, audition playlist and event-intent notes; keep originals and runtime manifests unchanged until reviewed
rules.unsupportedTrigger: If the client/server has no authoritative trigger, deliver the asset and mark binding unsupported; do not add gameplay events or synthesize a successful counter
rules.voiceCasting: Existing original draft VO remains the baseline; palette alternates may enter a level-matched review comparison only, with no final casting or replacement approval
rules.standard720: Retain existing 720p review MP4 set and three OGV samples. Runtime candidate remains 640x360; defer the full upscaled OGV set until a measured native requirement justifies it.
rules.motion: P0 candidate and continuity documents accepted for review; no final character lock, animation acceptance or runtime replacement is granted
